cases.answer:
A **P/E ratio (price-to-earnings ratio)** is a valuation measure that divides a company's stock price by its earnings per share (EPS). It tells you how much investors are willing to pay for each dollar of profit the company earns. A higher P/E suggests investors expect faster growth; a lower one suggests the stock is cheaper relative to current profits.
